Monaer brake parts supply by state

One distributor in Skudai, Johor. Workshops anywhere in Malaysia can order Monaer pads and discs on WhatsApp.

Check my car on WhatsApp

  • Johor

    Our home state. Workshops in Johor Bahru, Skudai, Kulai, Batu Pahat, Muar, Kluang and Segamat order from the same Skudai shelves, and we deliver to workshops across Johor.

    See Johor

  • Melaka

    Melaka is the next state up the North-South Expressway from Johor. Workshops in Melaka City, Alor Gajah and Jasin can send part numbers on WhatsApp and we confirm the part and stock before anything ships.

    See Melaka

  • Negeri Sembilan

    For workshops in Seremban, Nilai and Port Dickson, Skudai is a straight run up the North-South Expressway. Send the car and we confirm the part and stock.

    See Negeri Sembilan

  • Selangor

    Selangor is home to many of Malaysia's workshops, from Shah Alam and Petaling Jaya to Klang and Subang Jaya. Workshops there can order Monaer direct from the Skudai distributor.

    See Selangor

  • Kuala Lumpur

    Busy city traffic in Kuala Lumpur is hard on pads and discs. KL workshops can order Monaer nano ceramic pads, made for quiet stops and less dust, from our Skudai shelves.

    See Kuala Lumpur

  • Putrajaya

    Workshops serving Putrajaya and nearby Cyberjaya can order Monaer pads and discs on WhatsApp and get the part matched before anything ships.

    See Putrajaya

  • Perak

    For workshops in Ipoh, Taiping and Teluk Intan, we match Monaer parts on WhatsApp first, so the right box leaves Skudai for the long trip north.

    See Perak

  • Penang

    Workshops on Penang island and in Butterworth and Bukit Mertajam can order Monaer pads and discs by part number. We check every number against the car before it leaves Johor.

    See Penang

  • Kedah

    For workshops in Alor Setar, Sungai Petani and Kulim, send the car or the box label on WhatsApp and we confirm the Monaer part and stock in Skudai.

    See Kedah

  • Perlis

    Perlis is the far end of the peninsula from our Skudai base. Workshops in Kangar and Arau can still order Monaer by WhatsApp, with the part matched before it ships.

    See Perlis

  • Kelantan

    On the east coast, workshops in Kota Bharu and Pasir Mas can order Monaer pads and discs on WhatsApp. We match the part first and agree how it gets to Kelantan.

    See Kelantan

  • Terengganu

    Workshops in Kuala Terengganu, Kemaman and Dungun can send the car or part number on WhatsApp. We confirm the Monaer part and how it reaches the east coast.

    See Terengganu

  • Pahang

    From Kuantan and Temerloh to Bentong, Pahang workshops can order Monaer brake parts from Skudai. Send the car and we check the part and stock.

    See Pahang

  • Sabah

    Sabah is across the South China Sea from Johor, so we agree shipping before you order. Workshops in Kota Kinabalu, Sandakan and Tawau can send part numbers on WhatsApp.

    See Sabah

  • Sarawak

    For workshops in Kuching, Sibu, Bintulu and Miri, we match the Monaer part on WhatsApp first and agree how it ships to Sarawak before you pay.

    See Sarawak

  • Labuan

    Workshops on Labuan can order Monaer pads and discs by part number. We confirm stock in Skudai and agree how the parts reach the island.

    See Labuan
